name: Jina AI
tagline: Multimodal embeddings, reranking, and neural search APIs for AI applications
description: Jina AI provides developer APIs for embeddings, reranking, reader/search, and related neural search workloads. The platform centers on api.jina.ai with API-key authentication, self-serve access, and usage-based pricing. Primary products include text/image embeddings, rerankers, and web reading/search helpers used to build retrieval and RAG systems.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (or equivalent API key header per product docs); self-serve signup on jina.ai

example.request: curl https://api.jina.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"jina-embeddings-v3","input":["Hello world"]}'

use_cases: embed text documents for semantic search or RAG
rerank search results by relevance to a query
read and extract clean content from web pages
generate multimodal embeddings for images and text
